title: DataAvailability
description: ISO 25012-sourced data quality archetype — Availability system-dependent data quality characteristic. The degree to which data has attributes that enable it to be retrieved by authorized users and/or applications in a specific context of use. Rootless archetype — used as qualifier in Directives/Norms governing data entities. Source: ISO/IEC 25012 (System-Dependent Data Quality — Availability).

availabilityTarget.description: Target data availability percentage (0-100). Percentage of time data is accessible to authorized users.

accessLatency.description: Expected data access latency. IMMEDIATE = sub-second. LOW_LATENCY = seconds. MODERATE_LATENCY = minutes. BATCH_ACCESS = scheduled retrieval.

offlineAccessRequired.description: Whether data must be available in offline or disconnected scenarios.
